svg.title: Interactive floor lamp with editable light color
svg.desc: A transparent-background floor lamp with a black post and base, a silver-chain pull, and a cyan faceted pull bead. Pull the cord or click the shade to switch its color overlay on or off. The shade color is exposed as the --lamp-light-color design property.

g.title: Click the shade to toggle the lamp light.

g.aria-label: Pull down to toggle floor lamp light
g.title: Pull the attached silver chain down to toggle the lamp. It remains attached when extended.
